scope: Curated national AEAT subset for autónomos and SMEs; document identity, not filing eligibility.

models.title: Censo de obligados tributarios
models.description: Personal tax census registration, change of address or personal details; not business census 036.

models.title: Declaración censal de empresarios, profesionales y retenedores
models.description: Business/professional census registration, amendment or deregistration; IVA and withholding obligations.

models.title: Declaración censal simplificada (histórico)
models.description: Historical simplified business census; identify old documents only. Withdrawn 3 February 2025; not the current 036.

models.title: Declaración del IRPF
models.description: Annual personal income tax return, Renta, rendimientos, ganancias patrimoniales, base liquidable. Not the separate second instalment 102.

models.title: Segundo plazo del IRPF
models.description: Payment of the second instalment of the annual personal income tax return, segundo plazo. Not the main return 100.

models.title: Retenciones de trabajo y actividades económicas
models.description: Periodic withholding return for employment, professional activities, prizes and certain gains; not annual summary 190 or rent withholding 115.

models.title: Retenciones de arrendamientos urbanos
models.description: Periodic urban property rent withholding return; not annual summary 180.

models.title: Retenciones de determinados rendimientos del capital mobiliario
models.description: Periodic withholding return for certain investment income; not annual summary 193.

models.title: Pago fraccionado IRPF: estimación directa
models.description: Quarterly personal business income tax prepayment under direct estimation; not objective estimation 131.

models.title: Pago fraccionado IRPF: estimación objetiva
models.description: Personal business income tax prepayment under objective estimation, módulos; not direct estimation 130.

models.title: Resumen anual de retenciones de arrendamientos urbanos
models.description: Annual urban property rent withholding information return, list of recipients; not periodic 115.

models.title: Entidades en régimen de atribución de rentas
models.description: Annual information return for entities under income attribution regime; socios, herederos, comuneros, partícipes.

models.title: Resumen anual de retenciones de trabajo y actividades económicas
models.description: Annual employment/professional withholding summary and recipient details; not periodic 111.

models.title: Resumen anual de retenciones del capital mobiliario
models.description: Annual information return for certain investment income withholding; not periodic 123.

models.title: Declaración del Impuesto sobre Sociedades
models.description: Annual corporate income tax or permanent-establishment non-resident income return, balance and profit and loss; not instalment 202.

models.title: Pago fraccionado del Impuesto sobre Sociedades
models.description: Corporate income tax or permanent-establishment instalment payment; not annual return 200.

models.title: IRNR sin establecimiento permanente
models.description: Non-resident income tax self-assessment without permanent establishment; renta obtenida, inmuebles; not withholding 211 or 216.

models.title: Retención en adquisición de inmuebles a no residentes
models.description: Withholding on purchasing Spanish real estate from a non-resident without permanent establishment.

models.title: Retenciones IRNR sin establecimiento permanente
models.description: Periodic withholding on non-resident income without permanent establishment; not annual summary 296.

models.title: Operaciones vinculadas y determinadas operaciones con jurisdicciones no cooperativas
models.description: Related-party transactions and specified transactions/holdings involving tax-haven or non-cooperative jurisdictions information return.

models.title: Resumen anual de retenciones IRNR
models.description: Annual non-resident income withholding summary without permanent establishment; not periodic 216.

models.title: Autoliquidación del IVA
models.description: Periodic VAT self-assessment, IVA devengado, IVA deducible, resultado; not annual summary 390 or nonperiodic 309.

models.title: Autoliquidación no periódica del IVA
models.description: Nonperiodic VAT self-assessment, declaración-liquidación no periódica; not ordinary periodic 303.

models.title: Declaración anual de operaciones con terceras personas
models.description: Annual third-party transactions information return; not EU recapitulative statement 349.

models.title: Declaración recapitulativa de operaciones intracomunitarias
models.description: Recapitulative intra-Community operations statement, NIF operador comunitario, entregas/adquisiciones/servicios; not 347.

models.title: IVA: regímenes especiales de comercio electrónico
models.description: VAT self-assessment for OSS/IOSS special schemes, ventanilla única, régimen Unión, exterior o importación.

models.title: Resumen anual del IVA
models.description: Annual VAT summary, resumen anual, volumen de operaciones; not periodic self-assessment 303.

models.title: Impuesto sobre el Patrimonio
models.description: Individual wealth tax declaration, bienes, derechos y deudas; not large-fortune solidarity tax 718.

models.title: Impuesto Temporal de Solidaridad de las Grandes Fortunas
models.description: Large-fortune solidarity tax self-assessment; not wealth tax 714.

models.title: Bienes y derechos situados en el extranjero
models.description: Information return for foreign assets and rights such as accounts, securities and real estate; not virtual currencies 721.

models.title: Monedas virtuales situadas en el extranjero
models.description: Information return for virtual currencies held abroad; not other foreign assets 720.

models.title: IAE: alta, variación o baja
models.description: Economic activities tax registration, variation or deregistration, cuota municipal/provincial/nacional.

models.title: IAE: importe neto de la cifra de negocios
models.description: Communication of net turnover for economic activities tax; not registration 840.
